title: Chitin
synonyms: Chitin from shrimp shells, BioReagent, suitable for analysis of chitinase, purified powder

why_it_matters.text: The tough polymer that makes up insect shells, crab shells, and fungal cell walls. After cellulose it is the second most abundant biopolymer on earth.
